providers.name: groq
providers.notes: Create a Groq Console API key and set only GROQ_API_KEY in the environment. Never put a real key in this file. Optional model override: GROQ_MODEL.

providers.name: gigachat
providers.notes: Set only GIGACHAT_AUTH_KEY in the environment. Optional overrides: GIGACHAT_MODEL and GIGACHAT_SCOPE. OAuth access token is kept in memory only and never written to disk.

providers.name: gemini
providers.notes: Create a Gemini API key in Google AI Studio and set only GEMINI_API_KEY in the environment. Never put a real key in this file.

providers.name: openai
providers.notes: Set the API key in an environment variable, never in tracked files.

providers.name: ollama
providers.notes: Localhost-only Ollama provider. No API key, no cloud, no automatic install or pull. Optional overrides: OLLAMA_BASE_URL and OLLAMA_MODEL.
